newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian March wage inflation 4.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Italian March wage inflation 4.5 pct.

text.p: Italian wage inflation stood at an annual 4.5 percent in March, statistics institute ISTAT said in a statement.
ITALY HOURLY WAGE INFLATION March 97 Feb 97

Istat said wage inflation in the agriculture sector was 1.3 percent year-on-year in March, 4.2 percent in the industrial sector, 2.5 percent in the chemical sector, 4.6 percent in the metalworkers sector, 3.3 percent in the service sector, 1.5 percent in the transport and communications sector and 7.1 percent in the public administration.

The statistics office added that the number of hours lost to industrial action in January and February 1997 a provisional 3.5 million hours compared to 777,000 hours in the same period in 1996. This was mostly due to more disputes in the manufacturing sector, which includes metalworking, and transportation.
